item.title: Question Your Oracles
item.itunes:author: Enrico Gebauer
item.description:
This week's throughline: as agents make code and tests cheap, all the value moves to verification you can actually trust - from benchmarks agents have saturated, to making machine-written tests meaningful, to mutation testing as the metric with teeth, and the rise (and risks) of the AI judge.
In this episode: - OpenAI: Introducing SWE-bench Verified (the human-validated 500-issue benchmark agents are now saturating): https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/ - SWE-bench - leaderboard and the harder 'Pro'/live successors: https://www.swebench.com/ - Meta: Automated Unit Test Improvement using LLMs (TestGen-LLM - generate cheaply, filter ruthlessly): https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09171 - Stryker Mutator - mutation testing for JavaScript and .NET: https://stryker-mutator.io/ - PIT (pitest) - mutation testing for the JVM/Java: https://pitest.org/ - Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench (documents position & verbosity bias in AI judges): https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685
